idea-plugin.name: CollectionSync
idea-plugin.description:
Keep your Postman and Insomnia collections in sync with your code. CollectionSync — Endpoint Coverage Tracker compares the REST endpoints declared in your Java project (OpenAPI 3.x documents, Spring MVC, JAX-RS/Quarkus and Micronaut controllers) against the requests of your existing Postman (v2.1), Insomnia (v4/v5) and OpenAPI 3.x collections. The "Endpoint Coverage" tool window shows, endpoint by endpoint, which ones are covered, uncovered, orphaned or excluded, lets you navigate to the handler method, associate collections with project modules, exclude noisy endpoints from the calculation and export the filtered report as Markdown or CSV.

Main Features

  • Endpoint Discovery: Scans Spring, JAX-RS/Quarkus (jakarta and javax) and Micronaut controllers, or local OpenAPI 3.x documents, to build the list of REST endpoints. Kotlin controllers are scanned when the Kotlin plugin is installed. Every path of a mapping is expanded and mappings without an HTTP verb are kept as wildcards.
  • Collection Import: Parses Postman v2.1, Insomnia v4/v5 and OpenAPI 3.x (JSON and YAML), resolving known variables and tolerating broken files without aborting the report.
  • Coverage Tracking: Classifies every endpoint as COVERED, UNCOVERED or ORPHAN, with structural path matching (variables match by position, strict mode keeps {@code /users/{id}} apart from {@code /users/me}) and optional collection-to-module association for monorepos.
  • Exclusions: Right-click any endpoint to exclude it from the calculation (e.g. {@code /actuator/{name}}); excluded rows stay visible so the exclusion can be undone with one click.
  • Navigation: Double-click a row to jump to the controller method, or to the configured OpenAPI document.
  • Export: Export the report matching the current filters (status, text, module) as Markdown or CSV.

1.0.5

  • Build/compatibility release: targets IntelliJ IDEA 2026.3, upgraded build tooling and dependencies (Jackson 2.23.0, Instancio 6.2.1), PMD and formatting checks wired into the build, and full plugin verification against the recommended IDEs.

1.0.0

  • Endpoint Coverage Tracker. Coverage tool window comparing OpenAPI/Spring/JAX-RS endpoints with Postman v2.1 and Insomnia v4 collections: status table with filters, navigation to handlers, exclusion rules and Markdown/CSV report export.
